notes: Manufacturer tech-specs page (epiphan.com/products/pearl-nano/tech-specs/) is authoritative and confirms: 1x BNC 12G-SDI in; 1x HDMI Type A in (4K/60 capable, version not explicitly stated on this input, listed simply as "4K HDMI"); 2x HDMI out (port 1 = HDMI 2.0, port 2 = HDMI 2.0a pass-through — I used hdmi-2.0 for both since 2.0a is a sub-revision of 2.0, not a distinct grade tier); 2x XLR pro line-level audio in (+4.0 dBu); 2x RCA consumer line-level audio in; 3.5mm stereo headphone out; 1x RJ-45 10/100/1000 (also carries PoE+ as an alternate power source, not modeled as separate port); 1x USB 3.0 port (UAC-class, doubles as external storage connection). Also has an SD card slot (up to 512GB) and internal M.2 2280 SATA SSD bay — these are storage media slots, not cabled I/O connectors, so omitted from the port list per connector-focused scope. Power: external AC/DC adapter rated 12VDC/2.5A output (model SYS1588-3012), 90-240VAC input; the physical DC connector style (barrel jack) was not explicitly spelled out in either the manufacturer tech-specs page or product page text, so it is inferred from the product's compact/consumer-adapter power design (consistent with other Epiphan Pearl-family compact units) rather than directly confirmed — flagged as medium confidence for this reason. No RS-232/serial physical port confirmed (some third-party listings mention RS-232 via USB-to-serial adapter, which is not a native physical port and was excluded). Desktop/compact unit — no rack mount, so rackUnits omitted. Did not find a distinct HDMI version spec for the HDMI input; assumed HDMI 2.0 (same tier as outputs) given shared "4K" input claim, so that grade is inferred rather than explicitly stated for the input port specifically.
